summary:
Radar for 2026-11-12. Channel focus: GLP-1. Signals came from about 160 items, plus searches to check the top picks.

**What leads**
1. **FDA NAION (eye) label change, issued Nov 9 for the whole GLP-1 class, including tirzepatide.** Verified on Pharmacy Times, Healio and Ophthalmology Times, and mainstream outlets are still running it on Nov 12 (Guardian, BBC, USA Today, AAO, The Hill). The news is peaking. Search intent for "mounjaro eye warning" will last for months, and there's room for a calm, label-based explainer with the FDA's own numbers: 126 RCTs, 134,253 patients, 10 probable cases on GLP-1 vs 5 on placebo.
2. **ObesityWeek, Nov 14–17 in Washington DC.** This is a watch slot for the EloraTZP-style 48-hour head-to-head. Note that the REDEFINE 4 headline result (CagriSema 23.0% vs tirzepatide 25.5%) has been public since Feb 2026, so only new randomized data against tirzepatide qualifies.
3. **Proven practical tirzepatide topics (Lane A),** using label figures: injection-site reactions, dehydration, burping and heartburn, keeping results after stopping, plus Thanksgiving Shorts from Nov 18.
4. **Owner-mandated search formats:** a pen how-to (Instructions for Use only), a first-months timeline, a Foundayo what-to-expect, an approved-drug comparison with tirzepatide, and felt symptoms (nausea, heart rate).

**New items with weaker evidence (caution)**
- Nature, Nov 11: rare GLP1R variants reduce weight loss with semaglutide but not tirzepatide. Not checked beyond headlines.
- The "doubled heart risk after stopping" story, which traces back to the observational VA study in type 2 diabetes.
- New York Post: psychiatric symptoms after stopping. I couldn't find a primary source.

**Rejected:** compounded tirzepatide price reports, the Deloitte and employer coverage cuts, the Hims/Lilly deal, and the DJ Khaled Wegovy ambassador campaign.

**Sources checked:** pharmacytimes.com (NAION), healio.com (NAION and ATTAIN-OSA), ophthalmologytimes.com, hcplive.com and globenewswire (REDEFINE 4), source.washu.edu (stopping and heart risk), news-medical.net (23andMe genetics study), stockanalysis.com and tctmd.com (ATTAIN-OSA).

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide (Mounjaro, Zepbound) and the new FDA eye warning (NAION): what changed on the label, what the FDA's 126-trial analysis found, and which symptoms mean call right away
candidates.angle: A calm 'label change explained' long video. One sentence on what changed: NAION was added to Warnings and Precautions for the whole GLP-1 class, tirzepatide included. Then the FDA's own numbers in plain words: 134,253 people in 126 randomized trials, 15 probable NAION cases (10 on GLP-1 medicines, 5 on placebo), so it's rare and the evidence is mixed. Then the symptoms the FDA lists: sudden, painless vision loss or blurring in one eye, often on waking. That means contacting a healthcare provider right away. Open with a 'you' scenario: you saw the headline and looked at your pen. Thumbnail: a big eye plus 'RARE. BUT WHAT?' Don't use 'blindness' framing. Keep the 'don't stop without talking to your prescriber' line, scoped after the emergency line.
candidates.predicted_peak: News peak now (Nov 10–14); search tail of 2–6 months as prescribers and patients ask about it
candidates.why_now: The FDA safety communication and class-wide labelling order came on Nov 9. Coverage is still growing on Nov 12 (The Hill opinion, AAO explainer, WBFF, Yahoo, Fox 26). The owner names label changes as a 10–195x search format, and Lilly's label update for tirzepatide will add a second search wave.

evidence.signal: FDA requires class-wide GLP-1 RA labelling changes for potential NAION risk
FDA to require a NAION warning; meta-analysis of 126 RCTs, 134,253 patients, 10 vs 5 probable events
The warning applies across the GLP-1 RA class

evidence.source: Google News: AAO explainer, Guardian, BBC, USA Today (Nov 10–12)
evidence.signal: Mainstream pickup in the US and UK, still growing

candidates.topic: ObesityWeek 2026 (Nov 14–17): watch for any fresh randomized head-to-head against tirzepatide, including full REDEFINE 4 data (CagriSema vs tirzepatide, 84 weeks, open-label, 809 adults with obesity)
candidates.angle: Keep a 48-hour 'Did X beat tirzepatide?' slot ready, on the EloraTZP model. Ship only if new randomized data against tirzepatide is presented. REDEFINE 4's headline result has been public since Feb 2026 (23.0% vs 25.5%, efficacy estimand; non-inferiority not met), so a long video needs new full-data findings such as body composition, side effects or subgroups. Otherwise make it a 'what's confirmed?' 13:00 Short. Title it tirzepatide-first, in an obesity population, and call it open-label.
candidates.predicted_peak: Nov 14–19 (during and just after the conference)
candidates.why_now: ObesityWeek runs Nov 14–17 in Washington DC, and Novo has a CagriSema and Wegovy data page for it. A fresh randomized head-to-head against tirzepatide is the single format that earned 45% of our lifetime long-form minutes.

evidence.signal: CagriSema and Wegovy data at ObesityWeek
REDEFINE 4: CagriSema did not meet non-inferiority against tirzepatide
Topline: 23% weight loss, open-label, primary endpoint not achieved
Conference dates Nov 14–17, 2026

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide injection site reactions: redness, itching, small lumps. What the label reports (6–8% by dose vs about 2% on placebo), what's normal, and when to call
candidates.angle: 'Is this normal?' long video, matching Lane A item 1 in the playbook. Answer by 15 s: usually mild and short-lived. At 15–30 s, give the label number. Then: rotating sites as the Instructions for Use describe, what a normal reaction looks like, and the red flags (spreading redness, warmth or pus, signs of allergy, which are post-marketing reports). Link it to the Side Effects video in both directions.
keywords: is it normal to bruise after mounjaro injection
candidates.predicted_peak: Steady evergreen demand; a near-term lift from the 226-view Short
candidates.why_now: Fourth snapshot in a row at 88. Our two Shorts reached 242 and 129 views (a proven repeat theme). The playbook ranks it first among new Lane A videos, and the Side Effects end screen needs a target.

evidence.signal: Injection-site reactions by dose vs placebo
Injection-site Shorts at 242 and 129 views; named the top Lane A target

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide dehydration: signs to watch for, and why the label links vomiting or diarrhoea to kidney problems
candidates.angle: The felt problem is 'Why am I so thirsty or lightheaded?' Explain how eating and drinking less, plus GI losses, can lead to dehydration. The label warns of acute kidney injury linked to dehydration. Practical sipping habits come with no numeric prescriptions. When to call: you can't keep fluids down, you're peeing very little, or you're dizzy. Use the 'you' scenario of a bad stomach day.
candidates.predicted_peak: Evergreen; a small lift in December with holiday alcohol and travel
candidates.why_now: On the playbook's Lane A list, and it fits the kidney warning on the label. Very few creators cover it compared with nausea.

evidence.signal: Warnings and Precautions: acute kidney injury from dehydration caused by GI adverse reactions
Signs and when to get help

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide burping and heartburn: why slower stomach emptying causes sulfur burps and reflux, what the label reports, and what helps
candidates.angle: The felt problem, rated before Thanksgiving: 'Why do my burps taste like eggs?' Cover the gastric-emptying mechanism, the label's GERD, dyspepsia and eructation rates against placebo, then smaller meals, eating slowly, not lying down after eating, and noting trigger foods. When to call: severe or ongoing pain, or vomiting.
candidates.predicted_peak: Lift from Nov 20–30 around big holiday meals
candidates.why_now: Seen in 6 snapshots at a steady 80. On the Lane A list. Thanksgiving meals bring a seasonal spike in searches.

evidence.signal: GERD, dyspepsia and eructation listed among adverse reactions vs placebo
Self-care steps and when to see a GP

candidates.topic: Keeping results after stopping tirzepatide: SURMOUNT-4 (335 vs 335; +14.0% regain on placebo, still 9.9% below start) and why stopping should be planned with your prescriber, plus the observational VA heart data in type 2 diabetes
candidates.angle: Build next to Stopping (8.9% CTR). The short answer: many people regain some weight, and it varies. Then the habits linked to holding on: strength training, protein, a plan made with the prescriber. Mention the VA cohort only as 'linked to', in type 2 diabetes, and say it's observational. Never tell anyone to keep taking or to stop. Counter the Fox News '6 rebound risks' angle calmly.
keywords: what happens when you stop zepbound
candidates.predicted_peak: Peaks around New Year (late Dec to Jan) as people review costs and resolutions
candidates.why_now: Fox News (Nov 12) and CTV (Nov 12) ran stopping stories, ACSH ran '5 strategies' (Nov 12) and Medscape covered it Nov 7. Our Stopping video is our best Lane A CTR, so a follow-up has a built-in watch-next path.

evidence.signal: Stopping GLP-1 linked to more major cardiovascular events (VA cohort, type 2 diabetes, observational)
'Ozempic and Zepbound users face 6 rebound risks after stopping'
Randomized withdrawal: regain on placebo vs maintenance on tirzepatide

candidates.topic: How to use the Zepbound / Mounjaro pen: steps and injection sites from the Instructions for Use, plus pen storage for holiday travel
candidates.angle: Device how-to, with Instructions for Use content only and no amounts or dosing. Cover the sites the IFU names (stomach, thigh, back of upper arm by a caregiver), rotating sites, checking the pen, common mistakes, what a 'click' means, and the IFU's storage and out-of-fridge rules for flying or road trips. Point people to the pharmacist and prescriber for anything else.
keywords: can zepbound be out of the fridge
candidates.predicted_peak: Steady; travel lift Nov 20 to Jan 2
candidates.why_now: The owner names device how-tos as a 10–195x search format. Holiday travel adds storage questions (the pen-storage topic scored 78 last snapshot). There are few calm, faceless IFU walkthroughs.

evidence.signal: Official step-by-step and storage guidance
Device how-tos beat channel averages by 10–195x in this niche

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide what to expect: the first weeks and months (appetite, GI side effects easing, weight loss pace in SURMOUNT-1, energy)
candidates.angle: A 'what to expect' timeline, week by week and month by month, built from SURMOUNT-1 averages (adults without diabetes) and the label's note that GI effects are most common during dose escalation. Frame it as 'what the trials saw on average', not a promise. Give no titration amounts. Close each phase with a habit tip such as protein, fibre, water or lifting.
candidates.predicted_peak: Big lift in late Dec to Jan with New Year starts
candidates.why_now: The owner names this format. 'How Long' is one of our better Lane A videos (230 min, 85% late hold). New Year starts begin in about 7 weeks, so publish in late November to be ranking by then.

evidence.signal: 72-week weight-change curves for tirzepatide vs placebo in adults with obesity, without diabetes
GI reactions most common during escalation

candidates.topic: Thanksgiving on tirzepatide: feeling full fast, protein first, smaller plates, slow eating, alcohol, and easing nausea at a big meal
candidates.angle: Funnel Shorts from Nov 18 onward (not before), each a fresh question pointing to the Thanksgiving long video: 'Why do I feel full after 5 bites?', 'Will a big meal make me sick on Mounjaro?', 'Leftovers strategy'. Calm and anti-diet-culture. Don't put dates in the narration.
candidates.why_now: Seen in 11 snapshots, steady at about 93. The Thanksgiving long video rose from 17 to 93 min ahead of the peak. The owner says to hold Shorts until Nov 18.

evidence.signal: Thanksgiving long video up from 17 to 93 min; Short posted Nov 6 got 21 views (too early)
Delayed gastric emptying and GI reactions

candidates.topic: Foundayo (orforglipron) what to expect, label only, plus new Phase 3 ATTAIN-OSA sleep apnea results (not an approved sleep apnea use)
candidates.angle: An approved-drug search video. 'foundayo' is our top non-EloraTZP search term. Cover what the label says on taking it, common side effects and who it's for. Add one section on ATTAIN-OSA: about 44% lower AHI at 52 weeks in people not using PAP, against placebo. Say the sleep apnea use isn't approved and that Lilly plans to file. Avoid price, pharmacy or direct-to-consumer topics.
candidates.predicted_peak: 1–3 weeks as prescriptions grow; a second wave when the OSA filing lands
candidates.why_now: ATTAIN-OSA Phase 3 came out Nov 9–10 (Healio, TCTMD, MedPage, Time), and China approved it Nov 12, a wave of global headlines. Our orforglipron long video earns from search (111 of 262 min).

evidence.signal: Oral GLP-1 reduces sleep apnea severity and improves cardiometabolic risk factors
ATTAIN-OSA: fewer breathing interruptions
Up to 44% AHI reduction; FDA filing planned by year-end

candidates.topic: Foundayo (orforglipron) pill vs tirzepatide injection: what's actually different (how you take it, how it works, label side effects, trial weight loss) with no head-to-head trial
candidates.angle: An approved-drug comparison with tirzepatide, which the owner asked for. Pill vs weekly shot, GLP-1-only vs GIP+GLP-1, and what each one's own placebo trials showed (ATTAIN-1 vs SURMOUNT-1). Say clearly that the trials were separate, so the numbers can't be compared directly. End with 'questions to bring to your prescriber'. No switching advice.
keywords: is foundayo as good as zepbound
candidates.predicted_peak: 2–6 weeks; New Year lift
candidates.why_now: Foundayo record prescriptions, the China approval (Nov 12) and the new sleep apnea data mean people are asking 'should I ask about the pill instead?'.

evidence.signal: Lilly's GLP-1 pill approved in China
Orforglipron succeeds in Japanese patients with obesity

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide nausea: why it happens, when it usually eases, and what helps
candidates.angle: Felt symptom. Explain the gastric-emptying and brain-signal mechanism. Give label rates for both arms, noting nausea is most common during dose escalation. Practical help: smaller meals, stop at 'just full', avoid greasy food, sip fluids. Red flags: severe ongoing belly pain (possible pancreatitis: stop and call right away), or not keeping fluids down.
candidates.predicted_peak: Evergreen, with a holiday-meal lift
candidates.why_now: The owner names 'tirzepatide nausea' as a felt-symptom search. Our nausea Short got 180 views. We have no dedicated long video; Side Effects covers it only broadly.

evidence.signal: Nausea rates by dose vs placebo
Nausea Short 180 views (calm body-worry format proven)

candidates.topic: Does tirzepatide raise your heart rate? What the label reports, plus the new Apple HealthKit (All of Us) cohort on steps and heart rate after starting semaglutide or tirzepatide
candidates.angle: Felt-symptom Short: 'My smartwatch says my resting heart rate went up on Mounjaro. Normal?' Lead with the label, which reports a small average rise in resting heart rate. Use the wearable cohort as observational context only. When to call: a racing heart at rest, palpitations, or chest pain or fainting (emergency number first).
candidates.predicted_peak: 1–3 weeks; wearable-data stories tend to spread to creators
candidates.why_now: Diabetes Obes Metab, Nov 10: a cohort of semaglutide and tirzepatide starters using Apple HealthKit data in All of Us. Nobody covers it yet, and the wearable angle is new.

evidence.signal: Daily steps and heart rate after semaglutide or tirzepatide initiation: Apple HealthKit cohort
Heart rate increase listed in Warnings and Precautions / adverse reactions

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide and the thyroid warning: what's confirmed? Endocrine Reviews (Nov 6) review of preclinical and human data on GLP-1 medicines and thyroid cancer
candidates.angle: A 'label explained' Short or long video. The boxed warning is based on rodent C-cell tumours; whether this happens in humans hasn't been established. Cover who shouldn't use it (personal or family history of MTC or MEN 2) and which neck symptoms to report. Show what the new review adds. Reassure without dismissing.
candidates.predicted_peak: Steady search; small news lift within 1–2 weeks
candidates.why_now: Seen in 4 snapshots. A major review came out Nov 6. Interest in label warnings is higher after the NAION news, so a thyroid follow-up could serve as the NAION video's 'watch next'.

evidence.signal: GLP-1 RAs and thyroid cancer: review of preclinical and human data
Boxed warning: risk of thyroid C-cell tumours

candidates.topic: Why tirzepatide works differently for different people: Nature paper on rare GLP1R gene variants that reduce weight loss with semaglutide but not tirzepatide
candidates.angle: 'Why isn't it working for me?' answered with genetics as one of many factors. Effects are modest at the individual level, so tell viewers not to order genetic tests and to talk to a prescriber about response. Explain the mechanism: tirzepatide also acts on the GIP receptor. Check the paper's population and effect size before scripting.
candidates.predicted_peak: 3–10 days if science outlets pick it up
candidates.why_now: Nature article on Nov 11, with Bioengineer pickup Nov 12. Ties to the 'non-responder' searches. The earlier 23andMe Nature GWAS (April) gives context.

evidence.signal: Rare GLP1R variants attenuate weight loss with semaglutide but not tirzepatide
Earlier 23andMe Nature GWAS: genetic effects modest at the individual level

candidates.topic: Can I take ibuprofen on tirzepatide? Cohort study on starting NSAIDs and GI bleeding risk in people on GLP-1 medicines (Am J Health Syst Pharm, Nov 5)
candidates.angle: Practical question Short. Say what the study found, as 'linked to' and observational. The main message: ask your pharmacist or prescriber about pain relief, especially if you have stomach problems. No recommendations for specific medicines or amounts.
keywords: can i take ibuprofen on mounjaro
candidates.predicted_peak: Steady search; small lift in flu and cold season
candidates.why_now: Fresh study, and 'can I take X on Mounjaro' searches are high-intent. Cold season pushes demand for pain relievers.

evidence.source: PubMed: Am J Health Syst Pharm (Nov 5, 2026)
evidence.signal: NSAID initiation and GI bleeding in patients on GLP-1 RAs: retrospective cohort

candidates.topic: Retatrutide and knee osteoarthritis pain: what's confirmed from TRIUMPH-4 (NEJM, ACR 2026)
candidates.angle: A 'what's confirmed?' 13:00 Short. About two-thirds on retatrutide reached at least 50% knee-pain reduction vs 38% on placebo, in adults with obesity and knee OA. Say retatrutide isn't approved, and warn against 'research' sellers.
candidates.predicted_peak: Peaking now (Washington Post column Nov 11); fades over 1–2 weeks
candidates.why_now: The Washington Post column (Nov 11) and Everyday Health piece extend the ACR story. Retatrutide 'what's confirmed' Shorts get 82–280 views.

evidence.signal: Powerful new weight-loss drug may also ease knee pain
Retatrutide 'significantly' eases knee pain

candidates.topic: 'My skin hurts to touch' on a GLP-1 medicine: allodynia and dysesthesia reports. Uncommon, usually temporary, still being studied
candidates.angle: Calm body-worry Short ('Is this normal?'). Describe what's been reported and that it's uncommon. Use only the label's wording on dysaesthesia (if listed) and trial rates. Say when to call.
candidates.predicted_peak: 1–3 weeks
candidates.why_now: Mainstream pickup (NewsNation, Nov 6). It's a felt symptom with few calm explainers.

evidence.signal: Check adverse-reactions section for dysaesthesia/hyperaesthesia rates before scripting

candidates.topic: Mood changes or psychiatric symptoms after stopping Mounjaro or Zepbound (New York Post, Nov 11)
candidates.angle: Hold until a primary peer-reviewed source is found. If one is, make a calm Short: what was reported, the FDA's January 2026 meta-analysis that found no increased psychiatric risk while on GLP-1 medicines, and getting help (local emergency number for crisis). Never sensationalize.
candidates.predicted_peak: 3–7 days if picked up
candidates.why_now: Tabloid and syndicated coverage on Nov 11–12. Searches show no primary study yet.

evidence.signal: Some GLP-1 patients report psychotic symptoms after stopping

candidates.topic: REJECT: compounded tirzepatide price reports (Ozari, Join Luma), Deloitte and employer GLP-1 coverage cuts, Lilly–Hims & Hers direct sales, and the DJ Khaled Wegovy ambassador campaign
candidates.angle: Do not cover. These are compounded or gray-market promotion, cost or insurance topics (banned), or a brand ad campaign.
candidates.predicted_peak: n/a
candidates.why_now: High news volume, but this content violates brand guardrails and the playbook bans.

evidence.signal: Compounded tirzepatide price report
